QuestInfo.name: Stores Before the Frost
QuestInfo.0: #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k is worried about the Hollow's winter supplies.
QuestInfo.1: The Hollow's supplies have been tainted by #r#o54#s#k. Defeat #r50 #o54#s#k and bring 30 #b#t4000051#s#k to #b#p702##k so he can light his lamps.
QuestInfo.2: The #r#o54#s#k are defeated, and the lamps are ready for winter. #b#p702##k seemed to have something more to ask...

0.0: Oh, you're still here, human? Good. I could use a hand.
0.1: Our winter supplies are in trouble. I've been chasing pests out of the crates for days.
0.2: It's the #r#o54#s#k. They keep eating the supplies we've saved up for winter.
0.3: They wander in from #b#m010006050##k and #b#m010006060##k every year. Could you clear some of them out and bring back their #b#t4000051#s#k? Their glow is what fills our lamps.

no.0: All right. But the #r#o54#s#k won't wait for winter.

1.0: You did it! And #b30 #t4000051#s#k, too! You've saved me a week of chasing #r#o54#s#k out of the supplies!
1.1: The glow from their spores is what lights our homes. We've filled our lamps that way for as long as anyone here remembers.
1.2: We've managed to hold onto a lot of trade items, but it's been hard to gather actual provisions. Especially with the #r#o54#s#k getting into things. But thanks to you, I won't have to bother #b#p700##k to get more!
1.3: Take these for your trouble. And once you've rested, I have a bigger favor to ask.

npc.0: Still here? The #r#o54#s#k come in from #b#m010006050##k and #b#m010006060##k, and I need #b30 #t4000051#s#k.

item.0: The lamps won't fill themselves. I still need #b30 #t4000051#s#k, all right?

mob.0: There are still #r#o54#s#k sprouting between the crates. Please defeat #r50 #o54#s#k first.
